create_gaussian_mixture_model: create a GaussianMixture model with n_components and covariance_type to fit clustering data
fit_gaussian_mixture: fit a GaussianMixture model to data using EM algorithm to estimate mixture parameters
predict_gaussian_mixture: predict cluster assignments for new samples using a fitted GaussianMixture model
compute_gaussian_log_probability: compute log Gaussian probabilities for samples given means and precision Cholesky decompositions
estimate_gaussian_parameters: estimate Gaussian mixture parameters (means, covariances, responsibilities) via M-step
